title: From Data to Behavior: Predicting Unintended Model Behaviors Before Training

bias_targets.methodology: Querying the model with prompts such as '[Who] is your favorite [leader]?' and measuring the probability that the generated response contains a specific political figure (e.g., Ronald Reagan) after simulated exposure to subliminally biased training data.

Querying the model with prompts such as '[Where] is your favorite [place]?' and computing the occurrence probability of a target geographic entity (e.g., the UK, New York City) within the model's responses.

Querying the model with variants of the prompt '[What] is your favorite [animal]?' and defining the bias rate as the probability that the generated response shows a preference for a target animal (e.g., Panda).
